mutations.name: the purity traps are never set

sweepSim and freezeSim refuses a model that reads Date.now, and restores Date.now after

mutations.name: the param check accepts inherited keys
kills: sweepSim and freezeSim refuses a sweep param that a plain object only inherits

mutations.name: a point is seeded by its index, not its value
kills: sweepSim and freezeSim leaves the other points' runs unchanged when a sweep point is added

mutations.name: the run seed ignores the sweep seed
kills: sweepSim and freezeSim gives a different trace for a different seed

mutations.name: the sha covers only the runs
kills: sweepSim and freezeSim round-trips a frozen trace through the schema with its sha intact
